title: C01 Low-Compute Edge Inference Benchmark
prompt:
Create the C01 Low-Compute Edge Inference Benchmark verification dashboard for ClimateGuard AI.
Keep the identical styling, navbar, and sidebar active item: "C01 Edge Benchmark" (under SYSTEM menu in the sidebar).

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS FROM USER SPECIFICATION:
1. Strict Benchmark Constraints & Thresholds Prominently Displayed:
   - Target Inferences: 100 inferences
   - Maximum total latency threshold: Under 200 ms
   - Maximum operational memory threshold: Under 256 MB
2. Engineering & Scientific Credibility:
   - Default Status: Neutral "NOT TESTED" (or "STANDBY / AWAITING EXECUTION") state.
   - NEVER show fabricated PASS status or fake pre-measured benchmark values. Show clear "— —" or "Not Tested" placeholders with clear target thresholds displayed.
   - Prominent action controls: "Run Benchmark (100 Inferences)" primary button (with active/standby states) and "Download Report (JSON / PDF)" button (currently disabled until benchmark run).
3. KPI & Target Cards Grid (Row 1):
   - Card 1: Benchmark Status: Badge "NOT TESTED" in muted slate/neutral styling (`#64748B` / `#94A3B8`), subtitle "Awaiting test execution on target hardware".
   - Card 2: Total Latency: Target "< 200.0 ms" | Measured: "— — ms" | Status: "Pending execution".
   - Card 3: Average Latency: Target "< 2.0 ms / inf" | Measured: "— — ms" | Status: "Deterministic batch".
   - Card 4: Peak Operational Memory: Target "< 256.0 MB" | Measured: "— — MB" | Status: "Resident set size (RSS)".
   - Card 5: Model Artifact Footprint: Serialized Compact Decision Tree (ONNX / C01-Micro) Size: "18.4 MB" (Model weight on disk, well below 256MB boundary).
4. Dual Benchmark Target vs Measured Comparison Visualizations:
   - Visual 1: Total Latency Threshold Gauge / Bar:
     - Clear target ceiling line at 200 ms marked in cyan/amber threshold indicator.
     - Measurement zone showing "Awaiting Execution • Run benchmark to record actual latency envelope".
     - Visual breakdown of anticipated pipeline stages: Preprocessing / Tensor Normalization (<15ms), Core Tree Inference (<160ms), Anomaly Post-filtering (<25ms).
   - Visual 2: Memory Ceiling & Allocation Topology:
     - Target ceiling boundary line at 256 MB.
     - Stack breakdown: Base Runtime (<42MB), In-Memory Hazard Weights (~18.4MB), Dynamic Tensor Buffer (<65MB), Headroom (~130MB).
     - Status: "Memory Profiler Ready • jemalloc tracing armed".
5. Target Hardware & Execution Environment Panel:
   - Hardware Architecture: ARM Cortex-A72 / x86_64 Edge Gateway (e.g. Raspberry Pi 4 Compute Module / Industrial Edge Node).
   - CPU Clock & Cores: 4 Cores @ 1.50 GHz (Unthrottled, single-thread inference mode).
   - Total Available RAM: 1024 MB LPDDR4.
   - Operating Environment: Alpine Linux 3.19 (Minimal Edge Container) / glibc-minimal.
   - Runtime Engine: C01 Micro-Inference Core v2.4 (Zero-cloud-dependency, pure C/C++ runtime).
   - External Network Call Constraint: 0 External API Calls (100% Isolated Local Execution Guarantee).
6. Technical Architecture & Algorithmic Rationale Section:
   - Four explanatory pillars:
     1. Quantized Compact Decision Tree: Pruned gradient-boosted decision trees converted into static branchless C code arrays.
     2. Zero External Network Latency: Complete self-contained operation without satellite re-querying during local inference passes.
     3. Deterministic Execution Boundaries: Hard real-time execution guarantees avoiding garbage collection jitter.
     4. Extreme Serialization Footprint: Sub-20MB static footprint designed for disconnected municipal warning sirens and field gateways.
7. Benchmark Run History & Cryptographic Audit Table:
   - Clear empty state / baseline history showing previous environment tests or initial calibration runs:
     - Run ID (e.g. `BENCH-RUN-000` or calibration pre-run), Date, Hardware Profile, Inferences (100), Measured Latency, Peak RAM, Verification Result ("CALIBRATION ONLY - NOT CERTIFIED" / "NOT TESTED"), Action.
     - Clear helper text: "Official certified benchmark runs are cryptographically signed and stored in local edge logs."
8. Interactive feel:
   - Realistic tabs or controls (All Tests, Stress Test, Cold Start, Batch Size 1 vs 100).
   - Include banner: "HACKATHON HARDWARE CONSTRAINT VERIFICATION SPECIFICATION (C01 DEFENSE COMPLIANT)".

Style strictly follows ClimateGuard AI:
- Background: `#07111F`
- Sidebar/Navbar: `#0B1728`
- Cards: `#101F33` with 1px border `#24364B`
- Accents: `#22D3EE` (Cyan), `#3B82F6` (Enterprise Blue)
- Muted/Status colors: `#64748B`, `#94A3B8`, `#F8FAFC`. No fake green passes!
